ver: v6.1.7-RELEASE
feat: not-hat and cancel-events itemflag messages
fix: Folia AuthMe support

chore: rewrite item animation handler

Fixes item animations still being ran when the animations were suppose to be closed.
Fixes duplicate animation tasks when using `/ij remove` and `/ij get` causing animation flicker.
Fixes animation flicker when two players are viewing the same inventory. The item(s) will now animate based on the first viewing player.
Fixes the accidental closing of animations when items are removed or lost. Items could exist in containers so we should continue trying to animate.

chore: implement proper reflections caching

Improves performance on server forks utilizing on-the-fly remapping.
chore: deps
chore: deps
chore: improve handling crafting

feat: UUID String for skull owner

You can now specify the UUID of the player skin as the skull-owner to be set for the item.
chore: remove ProtocolLib soft depend
chore: support 1.21.4+ pick item handling
feat: translatable update messages

fix: item-repairable itemflag

Shift+Clicking the item into a crafting table would occasionally result in the item not being returned to the player.

feat: itemflag messages

You can now specify messages that will be sent when an itemflag is triggered.

Support has been added for the following itemflags; placement, inventory-modify, cancel-equip, item-store, item-modifiable, item-craftable, item-repairable, ip-limit, death-drops, self-drops, and erase-drops.

A message is defined by simply specifying the itemflag name `-message` e.g: `self-drops-message: '&cYou cannot drop items!'`
feat: Support 1.21.11

fix: death-keep for crafting items

Items were being incorrectly dropped when gamerule keepInventory was true. If dying fast enough it was also possible to have the items be dropped on death.

fix: item-store itemflag storing in pots

item-store will now properly block the storage of items in FLOWER_POT and DECORATED_POT.
fix: incorrect cooldown for on_hold commands

ver: v6.1.4-RELEASE
feat: Support 1.21.6

fix: always-give itemflag

The proper function of the always-give itemflag is to ALWAYS give the item upon performing a trigger or getting the item via commands regardless of the player already having the item or not.
This wasn't being respected and was not giving the item in the designated slot FIRST before adding it to the next available if the designated slot was occupied.

fix: incorrectly detecting empty slots

Fixes an issue with Paper where empty slots are no longer null, instead they are Material.AIR.

feat: model components

You can now specify model components for the 1.21.4+ resource packs.
Example;
```
    model-components:
      strings: 'chest_old'
      colors: ORANGE
      flags: 'true'
      floats: '20.0'
```
You can specify multiple values as well, example; `strings: 'chest_old, tutorial_sword'`
ver: v6.1.4-SNAPSHOT
ver: v6.1.3-RELEASE

feat: support custom sounds

Sounds from resource packs are now supported for commands-sounds and teleport-sound.

fix: item-store itemflag with villager trades

Now properly prevents the trading of items with the item-store itemflag.

fix: pale_oak_boat enum not present

Another stupid paper fix.

fix: economy balance checking

Now only checks the players economy balance if the custom item is using a commands-cost.
Fixes edge case errors with users not using economy while having a registered economy plugin in a disabled state.

fix: await MySQL connection

Players were able to join the server before the MySQL connection was established, resulting in players getting items they had already received.
When the server is starting up, it will now wait for the plugin to successfully establish MySQL connection.
Fixes issues with `first-join` and `ip-limit`.

fix: interact offhand commands

Certain command executors like `damage` and `swap-item` were non-functional for the offhand slot when using the `interact` command action.

chore: remove trim patterns enum

This isn't needed and was very convoluted. The trim pattern is literally just the NamespaceKey name + "_ARMOR_TRIM_SMITHING_TEMPLATE". Not defining static values allows us to dynamically support new patterns.

chore: update deprecated

Adds support for the new 1.21.5 methods.

Corrected by wokonago on Discord.
ver: v6.1.3-SNAPSHOT
ver: v6.1.2-RELEASE

feat: custom item models

model-data now supports model names in Minecraft 1.21.4+, versions below this will still take the numerical input.
Example; `model-data: example:custom_sword`

feat: saving NBT Properties

When saving an item via the in-game menu, NBT Properties will now be pulled.
This is VERY helpful as it adds support for plugins like ItemsAdder, ExecutableItems, and other custom item plugins without having to utilize their API (manually adding support).

fix: NBT Properties Nesting/Listing

This... never functioned from day 1... just randomly noticed this wasn't working....

feat: nbt package nesting

NBT Properties now support nesting, so you can implement keys inside a package. A package is defined by specifying it as a route, e.g package.key.
Example with a key having no package and two keys with a package;
`properties: 'TranslatableDisplayName:&aUltra &cItem, itemsadder.id:icon_next_orange, itemsadder.namespace:_ianternal'`

fix: chestsort indexoutofbounds

Would occur when other plugins utilize the ChestSort API with an inventory lacking viewers.
Now these calls will simply be ignored since they can't be handled anyways.
chore: folia tweaks

feat: dyeing leather horse armor

Minecraft versions 1.14+ now supports dyeing leather horse armor. The functionality is identical to leather armor.
fix: folia item commands

fix: dropping items running commands

If you dropped an item with an interact command while holding it, the command had a chance of being ran.
Recent changes broke the old check method for drops resulting in the drops check being ran after the interact event already triggered.
chore: funding

fix: database pipeline

Various fixes that should help improve database connectivity to prevent executions while the connection is refused.

fix: move-next loading legacy methods

Was causing major lag when the first player joins the server as Spigot was force loading unsafe legacy methods as a result of #setData being called for the move-next itemflag.

Furthermore this lag could result in the loss of the item being moved.

fix: improved %player_interact% accuracy

The value wasn't being passed from events that directly include this variable. No need to calculate when we already have the player.

fix: database columns

Changed the larger varchar to text to force MySQL servers to use the max 60k length.

fix: data saving to database

Larger inventories were failing to save to the database due to the limited character size.

fix: use-cooldown

Simply wasn't working with entities like ender pearls. It only was respecting fireworks and block placements.

feat: FIRST-WORLD active-commands tigger

Command(s) will be executed in every specified world upon entering the world.

fix: table purging

Tables failed to purge if a player argument was missing.

chg: middle click support

Middle click support for item commands has been removed in 1.21+.
Blame Microsoft.
fix: crafting definition

fix: return items

This simply wasn't working, items were being cleared after these items are returned instead of before.

fix: return items compression

Some MYSQL hosts couldn't handle the large Base64 string so it is now compressed to half its original size.

fix: old enum resolving

1.21.3 contained a change to replace old enums with the registry, this resulted in no longer being able to resolve the old enum names.
A change has been implemented to attempt to resolve the old names but it likely will stop working in the future.
fix: cancel-equip armor

fix: hide-attributes itemflag

Paper changed their ItemFlag functionality in 1.20.5 to be different than Spigot. This change made it impossible to hide default attribute values without setting dummy data.
feat: 1.21.4 Support

fix: cross-platform experimental features

Experimental features added by Spigot are sometimes missing in other forks like Purpur.
